name: OpenVibe.Website
description: OpenVibe.Website is the network's website builder: start from a real site (a shop, a portfolio, an event page, a link page, a product launch) or describe yours to OpenVibe AI, and change anything in the editor with a live preview beside it. Sites are built and kept on OpenVibe.Space with your OpenVibe account and served at yourname.openvibe.website or your own domain; publishing at a public address opens with public hosting.

pillars.title: Real sites to start from
pillars.text: Five whole sites, each a live page you can change line by line.

pillars.title: Describe it
pillars.text: OpenVibe AI writes a first version from a sentence; the code is all there.

pillars.title: Built-in sign-in and lists
pillars.text: RSVPs, guestbooks and polls keep their lists on OpenVibe.

pillars.title: Your own address
pillars.text: yourname.openvibe.website or your own domain, with every publish kept for rollback.

faq.question: Where do I build?
faq.answer: Pick a template on openvibe.website, or describe your site; it opens in the editor on OpenVibe.Space with your OpenVibe account, where your sites are kept.

faq.question: When can I publish at my own address?
faq.answer: Publishing at yourname.openvibe.website or your own domain opens with public hosting, after automatic abuse checks, a designated DMCA agent and the domain's Public Suffix List entry. Until then you build, edit and preview, and OpenVibe staff publish.
